measurementScopes.size: Compact serialization of collector exports; excludes HTML, assets, file manifests and formatting differences. Not live-site output directory sizes.
measurementScopes.memory: Peak RSS of the Node collector and serialization process, sampled before metric analysis; excludes Chromium.
measurementScopes.timing: Collector plus serialization in a synthetic fixture. Single sample; no site performance conclusion.

durationMs.conclusion: Not evidence for the S04 50% speed target; PR-02 is not implemented.
